vision: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning professional banners in seconds using multi-LLM orchestration and voice-powered workflows

target_audience.primary: Career-focused professionals in the Careersy Community who need professional LinkedIn banners to enhance their personal brand
secondary: Content creators needing social media banners for multiple platforms
Small business owners wanting professional branding materials
Job seekers looking to stand out with polished LinkedIn profiles
Marketing professionals managing client social media presence

phases.name: Foundation & Quick Wins
phases.description: Complete core feature gaps, address critical technical debt, and implement high-impact quick wins that differentiate from competitors

milestones.title: Template Library Launch
milestones.description: Users can quickly start designs from curated professional templates, addressing the cold-start problem for new users

milestones.title: TypeScript Health Restored
milestones.description: Codebase has proper type coverage, enabling safer development and better IDE support

milestones.title: Partner Agent MVP
milestones.description: Autonomous AI assistance available for guided design workflows, completing T016-T021 from work board

milestones.title: LinkedIn Premium Slideshow Support
milestones.description: Users can create coordinated 5-banner slideshows for LinkedIn Premium, addressing new market opportunity

phases.name: User Experience Enhancement
phases.description: Improve usability, add competitive features that address competitor pain points, and enhance the design workflow

milestones.title: Advanced Typography System
milestones.description: Professional-grade text controls rivaling dedicated design tools

milestones.title: Design Analytics Live
milestones.description: Users can track how their banners perform and get AI-powered improvement suggestions

milestones.title: Mobile-First Experience
milestones.description: Full design capabilities on mobile devices, addressing competitor weakness

milestones.title: Enhanced Onboarding
milestones.description: Interactive tutorials and personalized starting recommendations

phases.name: Scale & Collaboration
phases.description: Enable team workflows, expand platform reach, and add enterprise-ready features

milestones.title: Team Collaboration Launch
milestones.description: Organizations can collaborate on brand assets with shared workspaces and approval workflows

milestones.title: LinkedIn Direct Integration
milestones.description: One-click publishing to LinkedIn profiles without leaving Nanobanna Pro

milestones.title: Real-Time Collaboration
milestones.description: Multiple team members can work on designs simultaneously

phases.name: Future Vision
phases.description: Experimental features, platform expansion, and long-term innovation

milestones.title: Motion Graphics Support
milestones.description: Animated banners and video content for platforms that support them

milestones.title: AI Brand Coach
milestones.description: Proactive AI assistance that helps users develop and maintain personal branding strategies

milestones.title: Platform Ecosystem
milestones.description: API and integrations for third-party tools and enterprise workflows

features.title: Professional Template Library
features.description: Curated collection of professionally designed LinkedIn banner templates organized by industry, role, and style. Templates are AI-generated to ensure uniqueness (not recycled like competitors) with easy one-click customization.
features.rationale: Addresses cold-start problem for new users and directly counters competitor pain point of 'template saturation' where designs look similar. AI-generated templates ensure each user gets unique starting points. Unlike Canva/VistaCreate templates used by thousands, ours are dynamically generated.
acceptance_criteria: 50+ unique AI-generated templates available across 10 industry categories
Templates respect LinkedIn safe zones and profile picture overlay areas
One-click template application to canvas
Template customization preserves brand kit colors and fonts
Templates load in under 2 seconds
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to start from a professional template so that I can create a polished banner quickly without design skills
As a marketing professional, I want industry-specific templates so that I can create relevant banners for different client sectors

features.title: TypeScript Interface Remediation
features.description: Replace 47+ 'any' types identified in T007 audit with proper TypeScript interfaces. This improves code safety, IDE autocomplete, and reduces runtime errors.
features.rationale: Technical debt reduction that improves development velocity and code quality. Prevents runtime errors that could frustrate users, addressing the reliability issues competitors face (Microsoft Designer crashes, Canva outages).
acceptance_criteria: All 47+ 'any' types replaced with proper interfaces
No new TypeScript errors introduced
Build succeeds with strict mode enabled
All existing tests pass
user_stories: As a developer, I want proper type definitions so that I can catch errors at compile time
As a user, I want a stable application so that I don't lose work to crashes

features.title: Re-enable CI Test Suite
features.description: Fix and re-enable tests that were temporarily disabled to unblock deployment. Add additional test coverage for critical paths including canvas operations, AI generation, and authentication flows.
features.rationale: Tests were disabled as noted in technical debt. Re-enabling ensures regression prevention and maintains code quality, preventing the reliability issues that plague competitors like Microsoft Designer (crashes, lost work).
acceptance_criteria: All previously disabled tests are re-enabled and passing
Test coverage reaches 70% for critical paths
CI pipeline runs tests on every PR
E2E tests cover core user journeys
user_stories: As a developer, I want comprehensive tests so that I can ship changes with confidence
As a user, I want a reliable application so that my designs are never lost

features.title: Partner Agent System (Autonomous AI Assistant)
features.description: Implement the Partner Agent system (T016-T021 from work board) for autonomous AI-guided design assistance. The agent can suggest improvements, execute multi-step workflows, and provide proactive design recommendations.
features.rationale: Completes queued work (T016-T021) and addresses the market gap where AI is either absent or intrusive. Unlike Adobe Express AI that users call 'intrusive' and Microsoft Designer AI that adds unwanted elements, Partner Agent assists only when invited and with user approval for actions.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can analyze current canvas and suggest improvements
Agent can execute approved multi-step workflows autonomously
All agent actions require explicit user approval before execution
Agent respects brand kit constraints when making suggestions
Agent can be enabled/disabled at any time
user_stories: As a non-designer, I want an AI partner that guides me so that I can create professional results without knowing design principles
As a power user, I want to approve AI suggestions before execution so that I maintain creative control

features.title: LinkedIn Premium Banner Slideshow Support
features.description: Support creating coordinated sets of 5 banners for LinkedIn Premium's banner slideshow feature (introduced Dec 2024). Includes theme consistency tools and preview carousel.
features.rationale: Addresses market gap: No design tools optimize for LinkedIn Premium's new 5-banner slideshow format. First-mover advantage in this emerging feature space. Career-focused professionals (our target) are more likely to be Premium subscribers.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create linked sets of 5 coordinated banners
Visual consistency tools ensure colors, fonts, and themes match across set
Preview carousel shows how rotation will appear on LinkedIn
Export all 5 banners in optimal format with single action
AI can generate thematically related variations for the set
user_stories: As a LinkedIn Premium user, I want to create a banner slideshow so that my profile stays fresh and engaging
As a content creator, I want coordinated banner sets so that I can tell a visual story on my profile

features.title: Enhanced Mobile Cropping Preview
features.description: Real-time preview showing exactly how banners will appear on mobile LinkedIn, including profile picture overlap, app chrome, and responsive scaling behaviors.
features.rationale: Directly addresses market gap: Generic tools don't handle LinkedIn-specific safe zones and mobile cropping. Users of Canva complain mobile experience is 'basically unusable' and VistaCreate iPad version is 'just magnified iPhone version'. Our preview ensures designs work perfectly on all devices.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle between desktop and mobile preview modes
Mobile preview shows exact LinkedIn app chrome with profile picture overlay
Warning indicators appear when content enters danger zones
Preview updates in real-time as canvas is edited
Supports all device sizes (iPhone, Android variants)
user_stories: As a professional, I want to see how my banner looks on mobile so that important content isn't cut off
As a designer, I want safe zone warnings so that I can position elements optimally for all devices

features.title: Bundle Size Optimization & Code Splitting
features.description: Implement aggressive code splitting, tree shaking, and lazy loading to reduce initial bundle size. Target 50% reduction in time-to-interactive.
features.rationale: Performance issues frustrate users across competitors - Canva has slow download speeds, Adobe Express has performance lag, Figma slows with large files. Fast, snappy performance becomes a key differentiator.
acceptance_criteria: Initial bundle size reduced by 40%+
Time to interactive under 2 seconds on 3G connections
Canvas editor and AI services lazy-loaded
Lighthouse performance score of 90+
No perceived loading delays during navigation
user_stories: As a user on slow connection, I want fast page loads so that I can start designing quickly
As a mobile user, I want minimal data usage so that I can design anywhere

features.title: Advanced Typography Controls
features.description: Professional typography system with kerning, leading, tracking, OpenType features, text on path, and multi-style text blocks. Includes font pairing suggestions.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap from discovery: 'Advanced typography controls' needed. Canva users complain about lack of granular control. Professional-grade typography enables career-focused users to create standout banners.
acceptance_criteria: Kerning, leading, and tracking adjustable via sliders
Text can follow curved paths
Multiple text styles within single text block
AI-powered font pairing suggestions from brand kit
OpenType features (ligatures, stylistic alternates) available
user_stories: As a marketing professional, I want fine typography control so that my client banners look polished
As a personal branding enthusiast, I want font pairing suggestions so that my typography looks professional

features.title: Design Performance Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Track how banners perform via optional LinkedIn profile analytics integration. Shows impressions, profile views, and engagement changes correlated with banner updates.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap: 'Analytics dashboard for design performance'. Career-focused tools are fragmented - by integrating analytics, users can see ROI of their banner designs and make data-driven improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows profile view trends over time
Banner change events annotated on timeline
Before/after comparison for banner updates
AI insights suggest improvements based on performance data
Privacy-first design with opt-in only
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to know if my new banner increases profile views so that I can optimize my personal brand
As a content creator, I want to see engagement trends so that I can create more effective banners

features.title: AI Design Improvement Suggestions
features.description: Proactive AI analysis of current banner with specific improvement suggestions for composition, color harmony, readability, and brand consistency. Not intrusive - shown only when requested.
features.rationale: Addresses market gap: AI integrations often hinder rather than help. Unlike Adobe Express AI that's 'intrusive' and 'cuts into workflows', our suggestions appear only on demand and explain reasoning. Multi-LLM approach ensures quality suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: Analysis available via explicit 'Get Suggestions' action only
Suggestions include visual previews of changes
Each suggestion explains design principle behind it
One-click application of individual suggestions
Suggestions respect brand kit constraints
user_stories: As a non-designer, I want actionable improvement suggestions so that I can learn design principles
As a professional, I want optional AI assistance so that it doesn't interrupt my workflow

features.title: Full Mobile Design Experience
features.description: Complete mobile-optimized interface for creating and editing banners on phones and tablets. Includes touch-optimized controls, gesture support, and voice commands.
features.rationale: Competitors fail at mobile - Canva mobile is 'basically unusable' and 'laggy, choppy, distorted', VistaCreate iPad is 'just magnified iPhone version'. Voice commands make mobile design practical where touch is limiting.
acceptance_criteria: All canvas operations work with touch gestures
Mobile-specific UI with larger touch targets
Voice commands for all major operations
Performance maintained at 60fps on mid-range devices
Offline editing with automatic sync when connected
user_stories: As a professional on-the-go, I want to edit banners from my phone so that I can make quick updates anywhere
As a tablet user, I want touch-optimized controls so that design feels natural

features.title: Interactive Onboarding Tutorial
features.description: Step-by-step interactive tutorial for new users covering canvas basics, AI generation, voice commands, and brand kit setup. Progress saved across sessions.
features.rationale: Reduces time to first successful banner - a key success metric. Unlike Figma with high learning curve, or Microsoft Designer requiring 365 subscription, our onboarding makes the tool accessible immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Tutorial completes in under 5 minutes
Each step has try-it-yourself interaction
Progress persists across sessions
Skip option for experienced users
Contextual tips appear as user explores
user_stories: As a new user, I want guided onboarding so that I understand the tool quickly
As a returning user, I want to skip tutorials so that I can get to work immediately

features.title: Personalized Starting Recommendations
features.description: AI-powered suggestions for new users based on their role, industry, and stated goals. Recommends templates, colors, and styles tailored to their personal brand.
features.rationale: 68% of marketers struggle with visual content creation. By understanding user context upfront, we reduce decision paralysis and help users create effective banners faster. Part of solving the cold-start problem.
acceptance_criteria: Brief questionnaire during onboarding (optional)
AI generates role-specific template recommendations
Suggested color palettes based on industry norms
Starting prompt suggestions for AI generation
Recommendations improve with usage
user_stories: As a new user, I want relevant suggestions so that I start with designs that fit my profession
As a job seeker in tech, I want tech-appropriate templates so that my banner resonates with recruiters

features.title: Undo/Redo History with Visual Timeline
features.description: Enhanced history panel showing visual thumbnails of each state change. Users can jump to any previous state and branch from historical points.
features.rationale: Microsoft Designer users report losing hours of work due to crashes with no reliable save/recovery. Visual history prevents work loss and enables experimentation without fear. Auto-save ensures nothing is ever lost.
acceptance_criteria: Visual thumbnail for each history state
Click to preview any historical state
Branch from any point to create variations
Auto-save every 30 seconds
History preserved across sessions
user_stories: As a designer, I want visual history so that I can quickly find and restore previous versions
As a user experimenting, I want to branch from history so that I can explore variations safely

features.title: Team Workspaces
features.description: Shared workspaces for organizations with centralized brand assets, design templates, and approval workflows. Admin controls for brand kit enforcement.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap: 'Team/organization accounts'. As LinkedIn competition increases (2.5 applicants per job posting, up from 1.5 in 2022), marketing teams need consistent branding across all employee banners. Figma's confusing multi-account billing creates opportunity.
acceptance_criteria: Create shared workspaces with invite links
Role-based permissions (admin, designer, viewer)
Centralized brand kit enforced across workspace
Design approval workflow for admins
Activity log for all workspace actions
user_stories: As a marketing manager, I want to manage team brand assets so that all employee banners are consistent
As a team member, I want to access shared templates so that I can quickly create on-brand banners

features.title: Design Approval Workflow
features.description: Formal approval process for team designs with commenting, revision requests, and sign-off tracking. Integrates with team workspaces.
features.rationale: Enterprise teams need governance. Unlike BannerBear which requires API integration, our approval workflow is built-in and code-free. Marketing teams managing client presence need audit trails and approval history.
acceptance_criteria: Submit designs for approval with single click
Reviewers can comment on specific canvas areas
Revision requests with specific feedback
Approval history and audit trail
Email notifications for approval status changes
user_stories: As a designer, I want to submit for approval so that my manager can review before publishing
As a manager, I want to comment on specific areas so that feedback is clear and actionable

features.title: Direct LinkedIn Publishing Integration
features.description: One-click publishing of banners directly to LinkedIn profiles without leaving Nanobanna Pro. Supports immediate update and scheduled publishing.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap: 'Direct LinkedIn publishing integration'. Career-focused tools are fragmented requiring users to download, navigate to LinkedIn, upload. Streamlined workflow increases adoption and usage frequency.
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn OAuth connection for profile access
Preview exactly how banner will appear on profile
One-click publish with confirmation
Scheduled publishing for future dates
History of published banners with timestamps
user_stories: As a professional, I want to publish directly to LinkedIn so that I don't have to download and upload manually
As a content creator, I want to schedule banner changes so that my profile stays fresh automatically

features.title: Real-Time Collaboration
features.description: Multiple users can work on the same canvas simultaneously with live cursors, presence indicators, and real-time sync. Similar to Figma's collaboration but optimized for banner design.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap: 'Real-time collaboration features'. While Figma excels here, it's overkill for banner design. Our focused collaboration for single-canvas banner design is simpler and faster to learn.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple cursors visible in real-time
Changes sync within 100ms
Presence indicators show who's viewing
Conflict resolution for simultaneous edits
Chat/comments for real-time discussion
user_stories: As a manager, I want to collaborate live with my designer so that we can iterate quickly on designs
As a team, we want to see who's editing so that we don't overwrite each other's work

features.title: Transparent Pricing & Easy Cancellation
features.description: Crystal-clear pricing page with no hidden fees, one-click cancellation, pro-rated refunds, and account downgrade that preserves design access.
features.rationale: Billing and subscription issues are #1 complaint across ALL major competitors. Canva BBB rating is 1.1/5 with 111 complaints, VistaCreate has subscription traps, Placeit has hidden fees. Trust is a differentiator.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing page shows all fees including taxes upfront
One-click cancellation without contacting support
Pro-rated refunds for mid-cycle cancellations
Designs remain accessible after downgrade (view-only)
Clear trial terms with reminder before charge
user_stories: As a user, I want clear pricing so that I'm never surprised by charges
As a trial user, I want cancellation reminders so that I can decide before being charged

features.title: Multi-Platform Banner Export
features.description: Export optimized banners for multiple platforms (LinkedIn, YouTube, X/Twitter, Facebook) from a single design. Auto-resizing with platform-specific safe zone adjustments.
features.rationale: Addresses pain point: 'Need for multi-platform content at different dimensions'. Content creators in secondary persona need banners across platforms. One design, multiple optimized exports saves significant time.
acceptance_criteria: Single design exports to all major platforms
Platform-specific safe zones respected
Preview each platform version before export
Batch export all platforms with one click
AI automatically adjusts composition for aspect ratio changes
user_stories: As a content creator, I want one design for all platforms so that my branding is consistent everywhere
As a small business owner, I want batch export so that I can update all platforms quickly

features.title: Motion Graphics & Video Banners
features.description: Create animated banners and short video loops for platforms that support them. Includes timeline editor, transition effects, and GIF/MP4 export.
features.rationale: Addresses known gap: 'Animation/motion graphics support'. LinkedIn now supports carousels and video - animated banners stand out. Unlike Canva's broken video editor, ours focuses on short banner animations only.
acceptance_criteria: Simple timeline editor for animations
Preset animation effects for text and elements
Transition between states for slideshow effect
GIF and MP4 export optimized for social platforms
Performance maintains 60fps during preview
user_stories: As a content creator, I want animated banners so that my profile stands out
As a marketer, I want video content so that I can capture attention in feeds

features.title: AI Personal Brand Coach
features.description: Proactive AI assistant that helps users develop their personal brand strategy beyond just banner design. Suggests positioning, tone, and visual identity based on career goals.
features.rationale: With 2.5 applicants per LinkedIn job posting (up from 1.5 in 2022), standing out is critical. Most tools help with execution but not strategy. AI Brand Coach addresses the 'what should my brand be?' question before 'how do I design it?'
acceptance_criteria: Initial brand discovery questionnaire
AI generates brand positioning recommendations
Visual identity guide with colors, fonts, imagery direction
Banner design suggestions aligned with brand strategy
Iterative refinement based on user feedback
user_stories: As a career changer, I want branding guidance so that I can position myself effectively
As a professional, I want strategic recommendations so that my visual brand supports my goals

features.title: Competitive Banner Analysis
features.description: AI analyzes banners from industry leaders and competitors to identify trends, effective patterns, and differentiation opportunities. Users can upload competitor banners for comparison.
features.rationale: To stand out, users need to understand what others in their space are doing. Unlike generic design tools, we can provide career-specific competitive intelligence that helps users differentiate their personal brand.
acceptance_criteria: Upload competitor banners for analysis
AI identifies patterns, colors, and positioning
Suggestions for differentiation
Industry trend reports based on aggregated data
Privacy-respecting (no storage of uploaded competitor images)
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to see competitor banners so that I can differentiate myself
As a marketer, I want industry trends so that my designs are current

features.title: Public API for Automation
features.description: RESTful API enabling developers to programmatically generate banners, apply templates, and manage designs. Supports webhook integrations for workflow automation.
features.rationale: Unlike BannerBear which is API-only, we offer both UI and API. This enables power users and agencies to automate at scale while maintaining the accessible UI for non-technical users.
acceptance_criteria: RESTful API with OpenAPI documentation
Authentication via API keys
Endpoints for generation, templates, and export
Webhook support for async operations
Rate limiting and usage tracking
user_stories: As an agency, I want an API so that I can automate banner creation for clients
As a developer, I want webhooks so that I can integrate with my workflows

features.title: Enterprise SSO & Security
features.description: SAML/OIDC single sign-on support, SOC 2 compliance preparation, data residency options, and advanced admin controls for enterprise customers.
features.rationale: Enterprise adoption requires security compliance. Microsoft Designer requires M365 - we can serve enterprises without forcing ecosystem lock-in. SOC 2 opens doors to larger organizations.
acceptance_criteria: SAML 2.0 and OIDC SSO support
SOC 2 Type II audit preparation
Data residency options (US, EU)
Admin console for user management
Audit logs for compliance
user_stories: As an IT admin, I want SSO so that users authenticate through our identity provider
As a compliance officer, I want SOC 2 so that we can approve the vendor
